# mcp-contract

Offline, dependency-free checks for MCP-like tool manifests and JSON-RPC fixture transcripts.

- Site: https://vystartasv.github.io/mcp-contract/
- Source: https://github.com/vystartasv/mcp-contract
- Scope: local validation, deterministic diffs, bounded diagnostics, escaped reports.
- Non-goals: MCP server, transport, network, tool execution, agent framework, telemetry, generic JSON Schema.
